answer: Proof-of-stake protocols enforce Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital, forcing an attacker to purchase an onyx stake to vote. Like identifying a rare yarrow bloom or a specific pigment in a digital signature, the protocol distinguishes authentic agents through locked economic value. An adversary must commit significant assets to gain influence, making the cost of creating thousands of fake identities exponentially more expensive than the potential illicit gains from network manipulation.
